# seerr_sonarr_service (Data Source)

Read Sonarr service reachability, server summary information, and quality profiles from Seerr.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read all Sonarr servers reachable by Seerr
data "seerr_sonarr_service" "all" {}

# Read a specific Sonarr server by ID and its quality profiles
data "seerr_sonarr_service" "single" {
  server_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_id` (Number) Optional Sonarr server ID to query. If omitted, all Sonarr servers are queried.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier for this Sonarr service query.
- `profiles` (Attributes List) List of quality profiles when querying a specific Sonarr server_id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))
- `servers` (Attributes List) List of reachable Sonarr servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Quality profile ID.
- `name` (String) Quality profile name.


<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `active_directory` (String) Active directory for the server.
- `id` (Number) Sonarr server ID.
- `is_4k` (Boolean) Whether the server is configured for 4K.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default server.
- `name` (String) Sonarr server name.
